system.implants: Access Jacks, Basic Mesh Inserts, Brain Box, Cortical Stack, Eidetic Memory
system.advantages: +5 SOM, +5 to two other aptitudes of the player’s choice, Armor 6/6
system.description:
The biocore is a synthmorph with a biological brain. This design is favored by those who wish to enjoy the advantages of sleeving in a synthmorph without the risk of brainhacking or who simply dislike the idea of using a cyberbrain (including some asyncs). Most models feature a stylized but transparent braincase, to show off the biocore’s main feature, but others appear to be ordinary synthmorphs from the outside; only a detailed physical examination can determine that it actually contains a living brain.

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 11.
